test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six friends. They are sitting in a row facing north. P is sitting to the immediate left of R and second to the right of S. T is sitting to the immediate right of R. U is sitting second to the left of R. Q is sitting to the immediate left of S. Who is sitting at the extreme right end of the row?
solution:
**Given :**

 
• **Six friends - P, Q, R, S, T and U. **
 
• **They are sitting in a row facing north. **

**​Explanation : **

1) P is sitting to the immediate left of R and second to the right of S.

There are three possible cases for the position of S.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b27059787f11626fa8afbc54f36c3049f651b52ac624977ae8ae255c90b54f7.png] ​

 
• Case - (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fff69d0c96cc17063c579173387eb1582abf5e5d2e4dad1183b3e3b1e9a860b.png] ​

 
• Case - (3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/178f7ff3d60ba2277a6f967b7fc8c8c9679963c3fdc39bc1c4e05409c7129bd4.png] ​

2) T is sitting to the immediate right of R

3) Q is sitting to the immediate left of S. 

As in case - (1) there is no possible position for Q, therefore this case is eliminated.

As in case - (3) there is no possible position for T, therefore this case is eliminated.

 
• Case - (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f226f88f47288a0319b9b3d7fabf70b774c8456ad1790988c3730cf27b40265.png] 

4) U is sitting second to the left of R.

 
• Case - (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fef7685a815283d455905ae046b274f075a02505391ab7a59771851de975e6d5.png] ​

Thus, according to the final arrangement T is sitting at the extreme right end of the row.

Hence, **"T"** is the correct answer.
